question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

UERB, RHOE, ?, LNIK, IQFN
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First letter and third letter → (3) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter and fourth letter→ (3) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series. 

​So,

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6f5ce00a64ef3b085e4665017fd0dd04ac9adc73597e3ea6424a0d5deb74c65.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"OKLH**".
